newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas Advertising says not for sale.
newsitem.headline: Havas Advertising says not for sale.

text.p: Havas Advertising, a unit of media group Havas, said on Tuesday that it was not for sale.
"In order to avoid any erroneous interpretation, Havas Advertising wants to stress that it is not for sale," the company said in a statement.

Havas Advertising also said it planned to cut debt through the exercise of its convertible bonds and accelerate development of new markets in order to become one the five world majors, a goal set by shareholder Havas.
Havas chairman Pierre Dauzier recently said he would support all steps in that direction taken by Havas Advertising chairman Alain de Pouzilhac, the statement said.

Dauzier said last week that he wanted to keep the group's 37 percent stake in Havas Advertising but envisaged reducing the holding to 20 percent in the event Havas Advertising went into an alliance to further its international development. (( -- Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432))
